integrity: Complete analytical proof and reproducible exact-rational checks are supplied. Numerical checks do not substitute for the proof. No independent validation was conducted.
scientific_limitations: Not multi-cluster, nonlinear, adaptive-preconditioner, or finite-precision convergence
scientific_scope: Finite-dimensional real SPD systems with exactly two distinct eigenvalue levels, fixed right-hand side active in both levels, fixed symmetric perturbations, exact two-step conjugate gradients, and the Frobenius-optimal leading error coefficient.
title: Exact two-step conjugate-gradient energy sensitivity at a two-cluster collision
